title: Preachers & authors · Teachers · Bible Guide
heading: Five Centuries of biblical teachers
paragraph: 52 pastors, preachers and missionaries, from Heinrich Bullinger in Zürich to teachers still living today. Their sermons and books are in the library. Find one you know, or meet someone new.

blocks.text: 52 pastors, preachers and missionaries, from Heinrich Bullinger in Zürich to teachers still living today. Their sermons and books are in the library. Find one you know, or meet someone new.
Each circle is one teacher, placed by the year they were born.
Twenty enduring works. Find your next read.
A foundational account of Christian belief. Begin with Book I, on knowing God.
A searching, practical treatment of Romans 8:13 and the daily struggle with sin.
Follow Christian’s journey through doubt, danger and hope in an unforgettable story.
What distinguishes lasting faith from passing feeling? Edwards examines the signs.
Candid counsel on prayer, character and preaching, from Spurgeon to future ministers.
Direct, practical chapters on growth in faith, assurance and following Christ.
A gentle portrait of Christ’s care for weak and discouraged believers.
Richly illustrated teaching on the foundations of faith, arranged around the catechism.
Explore Perkins’s connected account of salvation and the shape of Christian doctrine.
A sustained meditation on Christ’s death, resurrection and intercession from Romans 8.
The Existence and Attributes of God
Take one attribute at a time through these substantial discourses on the nature of God.
Human Nature in Its Fourfold State
Consider humanity through innocence, the fall, renewal and the life to come.
Meet Wesley’s preaching on salvation, faith and a life transformed by grace.
Reflect on the believer’s fellowship with the Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
Grace Abounding to the Chief of Sinners
Bunyan tells his own story of conviction, struggle and the discovery of grace.
Practical counsel for guarding the inner life through changing circumstances.
Six lectures exploring the connections between Christian belief, culture and public life.
A forceful examination of doctrine, history and the identity of Christianity.
Short Scripture meditations for the beginning and end of each day.
Explanatory Notes upon the New Testament
Concise notes to accompany a steady reading through the New Testament.
Every chapter, lit by our teachers
All 1,189 chapters of the Bible, each lit by how many of our teachers' works take it as their main text. Choose a teacher to see the chapters they gave their work to.
One square is one chapter, Genesis to Revelation, reading down each column. The brighter it is, the more works take that chapter as their main text.
Spurgeon's sermons are 3,715 of these 7,408, so his choices set most of the brightness. Choose “Without Spurgeon” to see every other teacher.
Point at a square, or click it to keep it open, to see who took that chapter and read what they wrote.
Rooted in Scripture. Open for discovery.
A place to read slowly, ask deeply, and follow the connections. Scripture, study and the voices of Christian history, brought together for a lifetime of learning.
A library with a paper trail.
Meet the authors. Explore the collection. Trace each work to its source.
